parsed.summary: Tracing the schematic against the specification, the CM4 motherboard build matches the described architecture: the two MCP2515 CAN controllers (U11/U39) each use a 16 MHz crystal (Y6/Y2, not 12 MHz), sit behind isolated CAN transceivers (U47/U20) with SM712-style TVS arrays on the differential lines (D45/D44) and 120 R termination (R90/R72); the e-stop sink buffers (U29/U36/U12/U35) are wired as /OE-controlled open-drain sinks feeding the CAN connectors; the LTC4412 + P-FET USB OR-ing (U42/Q11), the PCA9536/ISL54222/FT231XS/SC16IS752 blocks, the WS2812 chain and the GLOBAL_EN path are all present. Reference-designator shifts between the spec's netlist and this build (e.g. spec U8/U9 vs schematic U11/U39, spec U5 vs U17/U31) are expected for a different build, and the remaining irregularities (USB diode path, GLOBAL_EN sequencing, CAN LED polarity, PoE inverted-power jumper, C5 footprint, 'switches backwards') are exactly the documented known issues/TODOs, which must not be reported. I found no drawing-supported deviation that would make the board behave differently from the intended design.
